in_sanskrit.name: Babuli
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessed with happiness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Babuli एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Babuli is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Babhru', which means 'happy' or 'blessed'. The name is often used for girls and is considered auspicious in Hindu tradition.
